Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Reports #68 and #70 document the original failure: an award recorded in one currency beside an entitlement published in another, on the same row. Deep pass 2026-09-08, 3/3: 'awarded' was defined as reward_status != 'pending_award', a whitelist of one string that fails OPEN, so renaming their status or dropping the field would have made every zeroed row an award of nothing against its band and sent a FAIL verification for a state the contract permits. Positive lists on both sides now; an unrecognised status is counted, not adjudicated.

RUN: run-20260908T150954Z-95f0a70, preregistration PRE-0073, on a clean working tree at commit 95f0a703e969d26a00e6d1924e99cd042e4ba55e. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.
